days.title: Srinagar arrival — Mughal gardens, then a shikara at dusk

stops.title: Wazwan lunch in Srinagar
stops.notes: Ask for a half-wazwan: rista, rogan josh and gushtaba with rice — one order feeds two

stops.title: Nishat Bagh
stops.notes: The Garden of Bliss — twelve terraces looking down the lake to the Zabarwan hills. The J&K gardens ticket is about ₹24 for an adult; carry cash

stops.title: Shikara ride on Dal Lake
stops.notes: An hour among the floating gardens and the vegetable market on water. Fares are negotiated per boat (₹400–800 an hour depending on the hour of day) — see the expense line

stops.title: Night on a Dal Lake houseboat
stops.notes: Booked direct with the owner, a houseboat is well below what the aggregators charge — and the kahn (boatman) will take you to the floating market at dawn

days.title: Over the meadow to Gulmarg — the gondola and the high pasture

stops.title: Lunch in Gulmarg market
stops.notes: Harissa and kulcha at the top of the meadow road, before the queue at the gondola

stops.title: Gulmarg Gondola, Phase 1
stops.notes: One of the highest cable cars in the world — Phase 1 climbs to Kongdoori. Phase 2 to Apharwat is a separate ticket and shuts in cloud. Fares are quoted between ₹740 and ₹1,010 return across sources; ₹800/person is budgeted below

stops.title: Gulmarg meadow walk at dusk
stops.notes: The meadow is the point of Gulmarg — ponies in summer, snow in winter, and the pine line all around it

stops.title: Night in Gulmarg
stops.notes: Staying up here rather than returning to Srinagar is what lets you catch the gondola before the day-trip buses arrive

days.title: Gulmarg to Pahalgam — the long road south

stops.title: Awantipora ruins
stops.notes: Ninth-century stone temples built by Avantivarman, sitting in a lawn beside the highway. A small ASI ticket is collected at the gate (see the ticket allowance)

stops.title: Evening on the Lidder river
stops.notes: The river runs through the middle of town; the walk upstream past the last guesthouse is free and better than any paid viewpoint

stops.title: Two nights in Pahalgam
stops.notes: Two nights here means the valley day tomorrow starts where you slept, not after a drive

days.title: Pahalgam's valleys — Chandanwari first, then Aru for sunset

stops.title: Chandanwari
stops.notes: The last motorable point towards the Amarnath cave shrine — glacier-fed water, pine all the way up, and ponywallahs at the car park. Local taxis or ponies only (₹600–1,200 a vehicle, see the expense line)

stops.title: Lunch back in Pahalgam
stops.notes: Local trout, if the kitchen has it — Pahalgam's hatcheries supply the town

stops.title: Aru Valley for the afternoon
stops.notes: A shepherd's meadow at the head of the valley and the start of the Kolahoi trek route. Walking is free; the pony ride to the far meadow is not

days.title: Back to Srinagar — the hill temple and the old city

stops.title: Shankaracharya Temple
stops.notes: A Shiva temple on the ridge above the lake, reached by a steep road and then steps. Free entry — phones stay in the car, and the view over Dal is the best in Srinagar

stops.title: Jamia Masjid, old city
stops.notes: 378 deodar columns around a courtyard that holds thousands — free to enter, quietest between prayers, covered arms and legs

stops.title: Last two nights in Srinagar
stops.notes: A city hotel this time — the old city is a walk, and the airport is 25 minutes away

days.title: Hazratbal, the craft emporia — and the flight home

stops.title: Hazratbal Shrine
stops.notes: The white marble lakeside shrine on the far shore — the boulevard drive around the lake to reach it is half the stop

stops.title: Kashmir handicrafts — paper machie, pashmina, walnut wood
stops.notes: State emporia carry fixed prices and certificates — the government Kashmir Handicrafts emporium is the safe buy for pashmina and silk carpets

expenses.label: Gulmarg Gondola Phase 1 return (sources quote ₹740–₹1,010; Phase 2 is a separate ticket at the counter)
Shikara ride on Dal Lake, one hour, per person share of the boat
Chandanwari and Aru union taxis or ponies (per vehicle, shared)
Dal Lake houseboat night — the real tariff sits above the standard-room estimate the engine prices
Small garden and ASI tickets not itemised (Awantipora, camera charges)

publication.title: Kashmir Valley in Six — Srinagar, Gulmarg, Pahalgam
publication.tagline: A houseboat on Dal, the world's highest gondola and two valley mornings in Pahalgam — the valley at walking pace, not convoy pace.
publication.bestSeason: Apr–Jun for the tulip garden and alpine meadows; Sep–Oct for the chinars turning red. Dec–Feb is snow-bound and Gulmarg turns into a ski town
travelTips: Book the Gulmarg gondola online the day before — the counter queue eats half a morning in season.
Stay a night in Gulmarg rather than day-tripping from Srinagar; the meadow at dusk and dawn is the trip's best hour.
Two nights in Pahalgam is deliberate. Chandanwari and Aru are both short drives from town and both deserve a full morning.
Hire a local car with a driver for the whole six days — the Gulmarg and Pahalgam roads are fine, but the valley's local traffic rules are not written down.
Keep the last day light. Hazratbal and the emporia are close to the airport road, so a late-afternoon flight costs you nothing.
warningsAndAssumptions: Gulmarg Gondola fares are quoted between ₹740 and ₹1,010 for a Phase 1 return across 2025–26 sources; ₹800 per person is budgeted here and Phase 2 (Apharwat) is a separate ticket. Verify and book at the counter or online.
Nishat Bagh's J&K gardens ticket is about ₹24 for an adult per the listings; the valley's garden rates are revised locally and change with the season.
Awantipora's ASI ticket, camera charges and garden extras are covered by a ₹100 ticket allowance rather than itemised line items.
Shikara fares on Dal Lake are negotiated per boat and are not regulated: budget ₹400–800 an hour for a shared boat, more for the full floating-market circuit.

The Dal Lake houseboat is priced as a ₹1,500/person premium over a standard comfort room, because the engine's lodging model has no houseboat tier. Off-season direct bookings run cheaper than any aggregator.
Chandanwari and Aru are served by local union taxis and ponies; the ₹600/person line is a shared-vehicle estimate, not a fixed fare.
All costs are engine estimates over real coordinates and cited fees, not quotes. Treat ±15% as the honest band.
